name: Genting Berhad
overview: 2026年，Genting Berhad 的主要业务动态集中在集团层面的融资活动：公司提出按比例发行新普通股的供股计划，预计筹集约12.5亿令吉。此外，公司续签了经常性关联交易的股东授权，并宣派了2025财年末期股息。所提供的公告中，没有披露各业务板块（Leisure & Hospitality、Plantation、Power、Property、Oil & Gas）的具体扩张、缩减、退出或新合约信息。
overview_en: In 2026, Genting Berhad's main business developments were at the group level: the company proposed a renounceable rights issue of new ordinary shares to raise approximately RM1.25 billion. It also renewed the shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions and declared a final dividend for FY2025.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 集团层面推进供股融资、续签关联交易授权并派发股息。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the company progressed a rights issue for fundraising, renewed the related party transaction mandate, and paid a dividend.

actions.title: PROPOSED RENOUNCEABLE RIGHTS ISSUE OF NEW ORDINARY SHARES IN GENT TO RAISE GROSS PROCEEDS OF APPROXIMATELY RM1,250 MILLION ("PROPOSED RIGHTS
actions.text_en: Proposed a renounceable rights issue of new ordinary shares to raise gross proceeds of approximately RM1.25 billion.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以进行具收益或交易性质的经常性关联交易。
actions.text_en: Proposed renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature.

actions.title: GENTING - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派2025财年末期单层股息每股5.0仙。
actions.text_en: Declared a final single-tier dividend of 5.0 sen per ordinary share for FY2025.
